info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Servicing By Param1-spec
info.description: The Loan Syndication Servicing API enables users to retrieve detailed servicing information related to specific loan syndication requests using a unique parameter. This endpoint facilitates access to essential data for financial institutions, enabling them to manage, monitor, and process loan syndication effectively. Typical consumers of this API include banking analysts, loan officers, and financial application developers who need to ensure accurate tracking of loan servicing progress and adjustments. The API supports enhanced decision-making and operational efficiency within banking services.

get.summary: Retrieve loan syndication details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific loan syndication identified by its unique ID. It provides all relevant data associated with the loan syndication for review or further processing.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving information regarding loan syndication for a specific loan identified by LOAN-500045. This should be formatted as JSON and must adhere to the specified schema to ensure proper processing.

GetServicingByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the Loan Syndication operation with the specified loan ID. The request body is expected to be a JSON string.
